summary: Zhihu Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing three Hong Kong Next Day Disclosure Returns and its 2026 Interim Report. The returns detail open-market repurchases of WVR ordinary shares (HKEX 02390) intended for cancellation, executed between July 1 and early September 2026 at prices ranging roughly USD 1.04 to USD 1.09 per share, each trade under about 0.05% of issued shares. Issued shares outstanding stood at 244,789,786 as of September 8, 2026, with no treasury shares. The buybacks represent a steady capital-return program; watch cumulative repurchase pace, cancellation timing, and any acceleration signaling management's valuation view.
